div.div: مُسْعُطٌ , (S, Msb, K,) and مِسْعَطٌ, (Lth, K,) the former an instance of the instr. n. with damm, (S, Msb, TA,) which is extr., (Msb, TA,) like مُنْخُلٌ &c., (TA,) The thing, (K,) or vessel, or receptacle, (S, Msb,) into which سَعُوط is put, (S, Msb, K,) and from which it is poured into the nose. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
